This artifact details configuration and installation requirements needed to support test execution in the test environment. Specifications for the test environment include, but are not limited to:

  • Basic software requirements
    • For example, operating system and other tools such as email
  • Basic hardware requirements
    • For example, processors, memory storage, hard disk storage, other input and output devices
  • Connectivity to ancillary applications or external vendor supported systems
  • Frequency of batch cycles
  • Special software and hardware requirements
    • For example, printers and sensor devices
  • Frequency of data refresh
  • List of files and reports needed for testing from test environment
  • Special job requirements
The purpose of this work product is to communicate test environment requirements for the test effort.
